title: Remote viewer locates downed Tu-22 in Zaire, per Jimmy Carter
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Remote viewer locates downed Tu-22 in Zaire, per Jimmy Carter, about 1970s at Zaire, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jimmy Carter, the former US president, went on record about a psychic who used remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind alone. According to Michels, Carter called it the craziest thing he experienced as president: the woman is said to have found a Soviet Tu-22 military plane that had gone down in Zaire, a country in central Africa, in the 1970s. Michels raises it because, if true, it would mean the US government had used psychics and found that they worked.
